title: Mobile UI Designer
profile: UI/UX Designer with 2 years of industry experience designing and shipping responsive mobile and web products, supported by an MSc in Design Innovation from Maynooth University. Experienced in creating user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes and production-ready high-fidelity UI in Figma, working within reusable components and design patterns to keep interfaces consistent across devices. Strong at simplifying complex workflows into clean, intuitive interfaces, grounding design decisions in usability testing and user research, and collaborating closely with developers to support accurate implementation.
